items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Native desktop tokens: system UI font (-apple-system/Segoe UI) on a 13px type scale (text-ui-2xs/xs/sm/ui/lg = 10/11/12/13/14px), Tailwind's neutral OKLCH ramp (white page and cards, neutral-950 text, neutral-500 secondary text; dark: #121212 page, neutral-800 cards, neutral-50 text, neutral-400 secondary text), translucent fills equal to neutral-100 for secondary/muted/accent, neutral-200 / neutral-800 hairline borders, an --accent-50…950 ramp (blue by default) driving primary (the 600 stop, white text) and ring (500) (accent presets: theme-neutral, theme-blue, theme-green, theme-orange, theme-rose, theme-violet), an eight-hue chart palette (chart-1..8: teal, lime, pink, sky, purple, blue, emerald, yellow), a 0.625rem radius with multiplier steps (sm .6x, md .8x, xl 1.4x, 2xl 1.8x, shell 1.3x), near-flat elevation shadows (raised, pressed, primary, well, surface, chip), shell/shell-border app-chrome tokens and a shell-inset utility for the rail layout, code surface and scrollbar tokens with thin rounded scrollbars and scrollbar-thin/-hover/-none utilities, reading tokens (max-w-reading 68ch, max-w-page, image outline) and a prose-qy long-form typography utility. Installs @qinyang/utils (cn that knows the text-ui sizes).

theme.font-mono: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, "JetBrains Mono"), "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

& :where(blockquote):not(:where(.not-pro.box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 70%, transparent), var(--skeuo-well)

items.name: utils
items.title: cn helper
items.description: cn() = clsx + tailwind-merge, extended so the theme's text-ui-2xs … text-ui-lg sizes merge as font sizes (not colours).

items.name: theme-neutral
items.title: Theme: Neutral accent
items.description: Neutral accent preset: sets the --accent-50…950 ramp to Tailwind neutral; a black primary with white text in light mode and a near-white primary with dark text in dark mode, ring neutral-400 / neutral-500. Install after @qinyang/theme.

items.name: theme-blue
items.title: Theme: Blue accent
items.description: Blue accent preset (the default): sets the --accent-50…950 ramp to Tailwind blue (#3392ff at 400); primary = the 600 stop with white text, ring = the 500 stop, in both modes. Install after @qinyang/theme.

items.name: theme-green
items.title: Theme: Green accent
items.description: Green accent preset: sets the --accent-50…950 ramp to Tailwind green; primary = the 700 stop with white text, ring = the 500 stop, in both modes. Install after @qinyang/theme.

items.name: theme-orange
items.title: Theme: Orange accent
items.description: Orange accent preset: sets the --accent-50…950 ramp to Tailwind orange; primary = the 700 stop with white text, ring = the 500 stop, in both modes. Install after @qinyang/theme.

items.name: theme-rose
items.title: Theme: Rose accent
items.description: Rose accent preset: sets the --accent-50…950 ramp to Tailwind rose; primary = the 600 stop with white text, ring = the 500 stop, in both modes. Install after @qinyang/theme.

items.name: theme-violet
items.title: Theme: Violet accent
items.description: Violet accent preset: sets the --accent-50…950 ramp to Tailwind violet; primary = the 600 stop with white text, ring = the 500 stop, in both modes. Install after @qinyang/theme.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: Rounded single-color outline icon set on a 24x24 grid: 1.75px round strokes, soft corners, glyphs that fill the box. Installs to components/icons.tsx; icons-puffy and icons-outline are the same names in other styles.

items.name: icons-puffy
items.title: Icons (puffy)
items.description: The icon set in puffy style: the same names and props on an 18x18 grid, filled shapes traced with a 1.5px round-join stroke. Installs to components/icons.tsx, replacing the rounded set; add icons with --overwrite to switch back.

items.name: icons-outline
items.title: Icons (outline)
items.description: The icon set in outline style: the same names, props and 18x18 grid, with every filled shape drawn as a 1.6px round outline. Installs to components/icons.tsx, replacing the rounded set; add icons with --overwrite to switch back.

items.name: icon-chip
items.title: Icon Chip
items.description: The house frame for title and header icons: a raised squircle in four sizes with neutral, tinted and solid tones, so every card header reads as one icon family.

items.name: saas
items.title: SaaS
items.description: Complete SaaS starter with real routes: marketing home (hero with a live product shot, logos, features, monthly/yearly pricing, testimonials, FAQ, CTA), pricing comparison and changelog; login, sign-up, forgot-password and email-code pages with validation and mock auth; an app shell with collapsible sidebar, workspace switcher, user menu, breadcrumbs and ⌘K palette; overview (KPI stat cards, revenue and usage charts, activity), analytics (date range, plan filter, charts, top pages), customers data table with detail drawer; settings for profile, account, billing, team, notifications and appearance; and a 404. All copy and mock data live in components/saas/lib/data.ts.

items.name: agent-workspace
items.title: Agent Workspace
items.description: Multi-provider coding-agent workspace and Agent Client Protocol client: icon rail, threads sidebar, thread tabs, split chats with work logs, approvals and edited files, a composer with mode / model / effort, and a terminal / explorer / browser dock. Runs offline on a demo agent; a bundled Node bridge connects Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or any ACP agent.

items.title: Stat Card
items.description: KPI card: label, big tabular number, a delta badge whose sign sets its tone (invertible for churn and latency) and a sparkline tinted to match.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What a list, table or page shows when it has nothing yet: icon chip, title, description and actions, bare, outlined or muted.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: App page header: eyebrow, h1 title, description and actions that wrap under the title on narrow screens.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage Meter
items.description: Quota bar on a meter: label, used / limit readout and a bar that turns warning then destructive as it fills.

items.name: settings-section
items.title: Settings Section
items.description: Native settings layout: section header, grouped card of label + control rows split by hairlines, footer band for Save, danger-zone tone and a settings sub-nav.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field: label, control, description and an animated error, wired with aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Input with a show / hide button inside its end edge; a field control like Input.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Pick-one control on a radio group with a raised thumb that glides between options: billing cycle, chart type, theme.

items.name: accent-picker
items.title: Accent Picker
items.description: Swatch picker for the theme's accent presets: sets data-accent on <html>, persists it, ships the preset CSS and a pre-paint script.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page controls with prev / next, numbered pages and ellipses, a compact mode, a results summary and a rows-per-page select.

items.name: workspace-switcher
items.title: Workspace Switcher
items.description: Sidebar-header team switcher: current workspace mark, name and plan, a menu of the others and Create workspace; collapses to the mark.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User Menu
items.description: Signed-in user button (avatar, name, email) opening an account menu; avatar-only in an icon rail or as a compact top-bar button.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Table with search, faceted filters with counts, column visibility, sorting, row selection with bulk actions, row action menus, pagination and empty / no-results states.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggle and toggle group: pressed-state buttons for marks and alignment, default or outline, three sizes.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Roving-focus toolbar with buttons, toggles, separators and inputs; floating (selection bubble) and inset variants.

items.name: menu-list
items.title: Menu List
items.description: Keyboard-navigable list that keeps focus elsewhere (aria-activedescendant): slash menus, mention pickers, autocomplete.

items.name: swatch-picker
items.title: Swatch Picker
items.description: Pick one colour from a fixed palette: colour dots or letter swatches, radio-group keyboard behaviour.

items.name: notion-editor
items.title: Block Editor
items.description: Block editor: slash menu, selection bubble, drag handles, markdown shortcuts, callouts, toggles, tables, code highlighting, and lossless MDX import / export.

items.name: email-editor
items.title: Email Editor
items.description: Visual email editor: buttons, images, logo, columns, sections, spacer, footer, {{variables}}, Show if / Repeat, subject + preheader, desktop / mobile preview, and email-safe HTML / JSON export.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Split panes with draggable dividers: percent or pixel sizes, live resizing, collapsible panels, keyboard control and layouts persisted to localStorage.

items.name: tab-strip
items.title: Tab Strip
items.description: Horizontal document and panel tabs: closable, drag to reorder, faded overflow scrolling and arrow-key navigation, in raised or pill style.

items.name: icon-rail
items.title: Icon Rail
items.description: Narrow vertical app rail of icon buttons with tooltips, shortcuts, badges and round status avatars; vertical or horizontal.

items.name: terminal-view
items.title: Terminal View
items.description: Terminal surface with ANSI colour output mapped to theme tokens, follow-the-end scrolling, a command line with history and a status line.

items.name: thread-list-item
items.title: Thread List Item
items.description: Two-line agent thread row: provider icon and title, then repo, pull request number in its status colour and branch, grouped under Recent / Today headings.

items.name: work-summary
items.title: Work Summary
items.description: Collapsible “Worked for 25s” step log of an agent turn: live elapsed time, steps with ACP tool kinds and statuses, and per-step output.

items.name: edited-files-card
items.title: Edited Files Card
items.description: Summary of the files an agent changed in a turn with total +/−, Undo and Review, and rows that expand to each file's diff.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model Picker
items.description: Composer pickers for agent model, reasoning effort and mode / access level: a quiet trigger and a menu with descriptions, groups and tones.

items.name: agent-composer
items.title: Agent Composer
items.description: Coding-agent composer with @file mentions and /command suggestions, attach and voice buttons, picker slots, a stacked banner area and send / stop.
